Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 check_package_failure;
 select distinct tk.test_id, test_desc
 into :ctrl_blk_1.test_id, :ctrl_blk_1.s_test_desc
 from test_kits tk, valid_tests vt
 where tk.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and tk.test_id = vt.test_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and

 then

 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and nvl(qc_flag,'N') = 'N'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);

 when OTHERS
 then

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number(6);
 temp_count2 number(6);
 cursor c1 is 
 select distinct test_kit_id, prep_date
 from usable_reagents
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and test_kit_id = nvl(:GLOBAL.test_kit_id, test_kit_id)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and nvl(qc_flag,'N') = 'N'
 and prep_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date, sysdate - 365) and
 nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,sysdate)
 and not exists (SELECT 'x' FROM test_kits 
 WHERE test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 AND test_kit_id = usable_reagents.test_kit_id
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id); 
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :s_to_date < :s_from_date
 then
 show_error('7023');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 begin
 if :s_to_date is null and :s_from_date is not null then
 :global.first := '1';
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from test_kits
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and to_char(:s_from_date,'MM-DD-YY') between to_char(insert_dats , 'MM-DD-YY') and
 to_char(qc_expiry_date, 'MM-DD-YY')
 and test_chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 elsif (:s_from_date is null and :s_to_date is null) or
 (:s_from_date is not null and :s_to_date is not null)
 then
 :global.first := '3';
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from test_kits
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and trunc(insert_dats) between nvl(:s_from_date,sysdate - 365)
 and nvl(:s_to_date,sysdate)
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 end if;
 select count(*) into temp_count2
 from usable_reagents
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and nvl(qc_flag,'N') = 'N'
 and prep_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date, sysdate - 365) and
 nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,sysdate); 
 if temp_count != 0
 then
 go_block('kit_info');
 :system.message_level := 5;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 end if;
 if temp_count2 != 0 THEN
 go_block('kit_info');
 last_record;
 for i in c1
 loop
 IF :system.record_status != 'NEW' THEN
 next_record;
 END IF;
 :kit_info.test_kit_id := i.test_kit_id;
 :kit_info.insert_dats := i.prep_date;
 :not_qc := 'QC Incomplete';
 end loop;
 end if;
 first_record; 
 if :system.block_status = 'NEW' then
 GO_ITEM('test_id'); 
 show_error('2001');
 else 
 :s_kit_class := 'X';
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('kit_info.test_kit_id','Bold-underline');
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('kit_info.insert_dats','Bold-underline');
 --display_field('kit_info.test_kit_class','Bold-underline');
 -- display_field('s_desc','Bold-underline');
 null; --PitssCOn display_item('kit_info.qc_expiry_date','Bold-underline'); 
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-MENU
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cursor c1 is 
 select reagent_type, reagent_code, lot_number, kit_lot_number
 from usable_reagents 
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id 
 and test_kit_id = :kit_info.test_kit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id; 
begin
 go_block('test_kit_info');
 :system.message_level := 5;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 IF :system.block_status = 'NEW' THEN
 for i in c1
 loop
 :test_kit_info.reagent_type := i.reagent_type;
 :test_kit_info.reagent_code := i.reagent_code; 
 :test_kit_info.lot_number := i.lot_number;
 :test_kit_info.master_kit_lot_number := i.kit_lot_number;
 if :reagent_type = 'C'
 then
 :s_type_desc := 'Control';
 elsif :reagent_type = 'R'
 then
 :s_type_desc := 'Reagent';
 elsif :reagent_type = 'S'
 then
 :s_type_desc := 'Substrate';
 end if;
 begin
 select i.reagent_code || ' - ' || reagent_name 
 into :test_kit_info.reagent_desc
 from valid_reagents 
 where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id 
 and reagent_type = :test_kit_info.reagent_type
 and reagent_code = :test_kit_info.reagent_code
 and rownum = 1;
 exception
 when others then
 null;
 end; 
 next_record;
 end loop;
 first_record;
 END IF;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if :reagent_type = 'C'
 then
 :s_type_desc := 'Control';
 elsif :reagent_type = 'R'
 then
 :s_type_desc := 'Reagent';
 elsif :reagent_type = 'S'
 then
 :s_type_desc := 'Substrate';
 end if;
 if :test_kit_info.lot_number != 'Prepared' then
select reagent_name into :test_kit_info.reagent_desc from valid_reagents where test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id 
and reagent_type = :test_kit_info.reagent_type and
 reagent_code = :test_kit_info.reagent_code;
else
 select reagent_name into :test_kit_info.reagent_desc from valid_reagents where
test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id and reagent_type = 'R'
 and preparation_flag in ('P','I') and control_flag = 'O';
end if;


 if :test_kit_info.reagent_type in ('C','R') then
 
select reagent_store_mst.kit_lot_number into :test_kit_info.master_kit_lot_number
 from reagent_store_mst 
 where reagent_store_mst.reagent_id in
 (select usable_reagents.reagent_id from usable_reagents 
 where usable_reagents.test_kit_id = :test_kit_info.test_kit_id) 
 and reagent_store_mst.kit_lot_number is not null 
 and reagent_store_mst.lot_number != 'Prepared';
 elsif :reagent_type = 'S' then
 :master_kit_lot_number := null;
 end if;
 


 

exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;

 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;
